subject: Re: Clearsummit trial top-up + structured discount request
messages:
From: Asha Mehta <asha.m@clearsummithealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
Cc: Randy Lee <randy.lee@clearsummithealth.com>, procurement@clearsummithealth.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial top-up & commercial concession request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Clearsummit product team liked the latency and inference controls. We kicked off a small POC this month but hit token consumption limits faster than expected because we expanded the prompt set.

We have two asks to keep momentum:
- A short-term trial top-up: additional $20k of credits to run a larger evaluation through June.
- A structured discount: if we commit to a 6-month starter package after the POC, can Redwood apply a 20% discount on the first three months?

Procurement asked me to surface this as an exec approval request because of the size and the combination of credits + discount. Can you confirm whether Redwood can make an exception on both items and what the conditions would be?

Appreciate any help — we want to keep the pilot moving.

Best,
Asha Mehta
Head of Product Ops
Clearsummit Health

Attachments: (none in this message)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.m@clearsummithealth.com>
Cc: Randy Lee <randy.lee@clearsummithealth.com>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial top-up & commercial concession request

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask and context. We want Clearsummit to be successful and can usually support a short-term top-up plus a time-limited commercial sweetener when there's a clear path to a committed deployment.

Prelim proposal (subject to internal approval):
- Trial top-up: $25,000 in evaluation credits (to ensure no throttling for the expanded prompt set).
- Structured discount: 20% off the monthly list rate for months 1–3 of a 6-month starter commitment (customer must sign the starter order within 30 days of credits being applied).

Conditions:
- 6-month minimum commitment at the start of production (standard SLA applies).
- We require a short mutual action plan and a single signed order form (I can send the updated quote).
- Credits to be applied once DocuSign is executed and procurement has confirmed billing details.

I'll escalate for exec clearance today — looping in Ben for number validation and Marissa for approval. Attaching a one-page commercial summary.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: clearsummit-commercial-summary.pdf (1 page, pricing and conditions)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Clearsummit trial top-up + structured discount — approval request

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Clearsummit's ask and my proposed concession above. Key items: $25k credit top-up + 20% on months 1–3 for a 6-month commit.

Why approve:
- Clearsummit is a high-fit account (healthcare analytics) with strong product signals; pilot shows product/infra fit.
- Expected initial monthly run-rate post-POC of ~$45k; the concession accelerates conversion and reduces churn risk in the first six months.
- Credit is one-time and will be tied to DocuSign + committed order.

Financials (net impact estimate):
- Gross revenue converted in first 6 months: ~$230k
- Discounted revenue reduction (20% M1–M3): ~$27k
- Credits applied (one-time): $25k
- Net first-half take: ~178k (assuming conversion). Incremental lifetime value and reference case potential expected to offset concession.

Request: sign-off (approve/decline) so I can finalize the quote and issue DocuSign. If approved, legal will need to confirm a standard order form + credit attachment.

Thanks,
Vivek
